file_impact.reason: Add current_head_sha(auth_manifest, repo_root) shared helper: the SINGLE source of the unscoped current-head anchor. Attested -> resolve the current gate ref (resolve_ref/default_ref, fetch=False); legacy/source=local -> head_sha. Raises SnapshotError on an unresolvable attested gate ref (fail closed, no foreign value).

Refactor _unscoped_head_drift to delegate to gate_source.current_head_sha instead of git rev-parse HEAD of the evaluator working tree; catch SnapshotError -> fail-closed reason; legacy/source=local keep the head_sha read via the shared helper.

code_drifted (Pass-3 finding-drop eligibility) sourced the byte-identical unscoped head_sha read; route it through the shared gate_source.current_head_sha so the two intentionally-synchronized anchors cannot diverge; catch SnapshotError -> unknown (deny convergence, never suppress).

RED->GREEN oracle: attested unscoped attestation certified at an unmoved origin/main gate ref stays valid from a foreign working-tree HEAD (positive), still stale-head when the gate ref genuinely moves (negative control), plus a shared-helper real-store test for current_head_sha.
Teeth tests for the drift_floor consumer: the candidate reads the shared gate-ref anchor not the working tree, and denies convergence (never suppresses) when the gate ref is unresolvable.
